* Mention dest of the Best Buys column, ''InQuest Gamer'' #79 (November 2001), p. 27: SWCCG Coruscant blurb plus the surrounding Best Buys listings on the same page, corrected against opened jp2 page scan [[File:InQuest 79 page 27.jpg]] from archive.org/details/IQ.Gamer.Partial.Collection (inquest.079.-.nov.2001.-.harry.potter.ccg_jp2.zip; jp2 0015 = printed 27).
* Photo in the Coruscant blurb is Darth Maul, Young Apprentice; body text says Darth Maul. Printed price $3.29 per 11-card booster (djvu OCR had $2.29). Printed "wamprats" and lowercase "the force" kept.
